title: Prawn avocado chilli salad
summary: Prawn avocado chilli salad is a mexican dinner built around raw king prawns and avocados, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook raw king prawns for Prawn avocado chilli salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm little gem lettuce alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss avocados with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Prawn avocado chilli salad straight away. Taste Prawn avocado chilli salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
